description: RAG groundedness / hallucination check — Check whether an AI answer is backed by its source text (RAG faithfulness). Splits the answer into atomic claims and labels each SUPPORTED, CONTRADICTED or NOT_IN_CONTEXT using only the context, with an evidence quote that is verified offline against the context. Returns a faithfulness score and verdict GROUNDED / MOSTLY_GROUNDED / UNGROUNDED / UNFAITHFUL. Params: context= (source text, up to 24k chars) or url= (page to use as context), answer= (text to check), optional question=. Price: $0.012 USDC (Base, via x402).

answer.description: e.g. The Eiffel Tower was finished in 1889 and is about 330 m tall. It was designed by Gustave Eiffel.

context.description: e.g. The Eiffel Tower is 330 metres tall. It was completed in 1889 as the entrance arch for the World's Fair in Paris.

name: ai_groundedness
